create.name: The Brothers Koren
create.bio:
The Brothers Koren are Isaac and Thorald Koren, Australian-born brothers who moved to New York with their mother. For around fifteen years they performed as the band The Kin, earning a gold record and supporting acts including Coldplay, Bon Jovi, P!NK and Rod Stewart. In 2015 they left touring behind to teach, and created The Songwriter's Journey, a small-group programme that guides people with no musical background from a first idea all the way to a finished, recorded song of their own.

They approach the voice as an instrument of the whole body, and singing as a way back to presence, self-expression and belonging. Toning, breath, group singing, improvisation and songwriting are their tools, with the emphasis on play and on being heard rather than on technique. As well as their own online programmes and the Embodied Voice Portal membership, they run weekend workshops at Esalen, a free monthly online gathering called The Choir, and several courses on The Shift Network. They have given a TEDx talk and co-created The Journey, a documentary about the voice.

courses.title: Your Mystic Voice
courses.description: A self-paced seven-module course using breath, toning and chant to explore the voice as a spiritual practice. It draws on ancestral toning, Sufi chanting and call-and-response singing, and guides students to create their own mantras and songs.

courses.title: Your Harmonious Voice
courses.description: A self-paced seven-module course on singing in harmony with yourself and others, with no musical experience needed. It covers basic harmony, group singing, songwriting and building a personal daily voice practice.

courses.title: Awaken & Celebrate Your Sacred Voice to Come Home to Your Authentic Self
courses.description: A seven-module on-demand course exploring your personal 'musical cosmology', the songs that move you most. It works with the inner voices that hold back self-expression and ends with singing in community.

courses.title: Fall in Love With Your Soul's Voice Through Song
courses.description: A seven-module on-demand course on quietening the self-critical voices that stop people singing. Students are guided through five stages of writing a song of their own, with a guest session from Eileen McKusick.

courses.title: Embodied Voice Portal
courses.description: A monthly membership for ongoing voice practice, with monthly themes, a library of guided vocal practices and meditations, and two live online sessions a week. The first month is free and includes the Coming Home to Your Voice practice.

courses.title: The Songwriter's Journey
courses.description: The Brothers' flagship small-group programme, held live on Zoom over several months, taking participants through a staged process to write a song of their own. No songwriting experience is needed, and a fuller option adds private voice coaching and a professional recording.

courses.title: The Healing Voice: Exploring the Sonic Anatomy (Esalen)
courses.description: A weekend workshop at Esalen in Big Sur, co-led with sound therapist Eileen McKusick, on finding presence and aliveness through the voice. Open to beginners and experienced singers alike.

courses.title: Reawaken Your Creative Process: Reclaim Your Voice and Remember Your Creative Power (Esalen)
courses.description: A weekend at Esalen exploring your own creative process through embodied voice techniques, creative process design and collaborative games. All creative forms are welcome, not only music.

free_resources.title: Your Life's Song: Free 5-Minute Audio Journey
free_resources.description: A short guided audio journey for exploring your voice in a relaxed, voice-positive way. It is sent by email after signing up.

free_resources.title: The Choir with The Brothers Koren
free_resources.description: A free monthly gathering on Zoom with singalongs, stories and playful voice challenges. No singing experience is needed.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @thebrotherskoren 3.77K subscribers (channel page, 31 Oct 2026); second channel @brotherskoren3410 165; Instagram @brotherskoren 18K (og:description); Facebook page count not readable (only a group linked) → ~22k total → local_hero
flags: Duo listed as one listing: both photos necessarily show the two brothers together (Isaac and Thorald), not one person.
Their earlier band The Kin had a larger following (gold record, Coldplay support slots); that band's audience is not counted in the tier.
Their site also publishes info@brotherskoren.com (on the Coming Home, Your True Voice and Embodied Voice Portal pages); the contact page shows brotherskoren@gmail.com, which is used here.
The Songwriter's Journey dates disagree: the home page says it starts December 8 (year not given, taken as 2026), while the Programs page still says July 28, 2026 and a 9-month length; please check.

Esalen prices are taken as the lowest published figure ($940, which appears to be commuter/off-site tuition); the Esalen 'The Healing Voice' title uses 'healing' but names no condition, so it was kept.
The YouTube video 'Inner Resonance: How To Reset Your Nervous System' was left out as borderline wellness wording.
left_out: Shift course 'Awaken Inner Healing With the Power of Your Voice' ($247 USD): includes a module on working with trauma, grief and 'dis-ease' through song (health-claim rule, borderline).
Shift course 'Awaken Your Creative Life Force Through Song' ($694 USD): page discusses anxiety and depression and has a module on processing trauma through song (health-claim rule).
Four further Shift programmes behind the 'Load more' button could not be read.
Your True Voice (8 weeks, began 14 Oct 2026) and Coming Home to Your Voice live cohort (began 26 Oct 2026): already started.
Yoga Soup evenings (11 Sep 2026 passed; 20 Nov 2026 album release concert is a performance, not teaching) and One Big Night (26 Sep 2026, passed).
Private coaching: one-to-one is not their main way of working.

Videos: music videos (Trust, What Happens Now, Arise, Freedom Road), clips under 2 minutes and Shorts, a duplicate upload of 'Freedom To Feel', the Solstice session co-led with Dr. Sue Morter, 'Is Stage Fright Your Problem or Your Friend?' (borderline condition wording), and videos on other channels (TEDx performance of The Kin, interviews).
No books found on Amazon by Isaac, Thorald or the Brothers Koren.
